typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SourceSystemId as long,
		SourceSystemCode as string,
		SourceSystemName as string,
		SourceSystemDesc as string,
		LoadDate as timestamp,
		AutoAsOfDateInd as string,
		Id as string,
		int as integer,
		Operator as string,
		Id2 as string,
		StartTime as timestamp,
		EndTime as timestamp,
		datacode as integer,
		message as string,
		Staging as string,
		BatchId as integer,
		ClaimMergeHistoryInd as short,
		SourceSystemURL as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select *  ,Id =newid() ,int=BatchId ,Operator=cast(\'YDL\' as nvarchar(3)) ,Id2 =newid()    ,[StartTime]=getdate()       ,[EndTime]=getdate() 		,[datacode]=BatchId 		,message = cast(\'BatchId =\'+ cast(BatchId as nvarchar(40))as nvarchar(2000)) 		,Staging=db_name() from control.sourceSystem;',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(SourceSystemId = SourceSystemId) ~> PlaceHolderYodilHashTransformation
PlaceHolderYodilHashTransformation sink(input(
		sourceid as string,
		executionid as string,
		computer as string,
		endtime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		source as string,
		starttime as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		event as string,
		message as string,
		operator as string,
		datacode as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		sourceid = Id,
		executionid = Id2,
		computer = SourceSystemName,
		endtime = EndTime,
		source = SourceSystemCode,
		starttime = StartTime,
		event = Staging,
		message,
		operator = Operator,
		datacode)) ~> DSTSSISLog
